scenes.title: The Ancient Book
scenes.en: Every Friday, our class has show and tell. Mia brings an ancient book. Its main character is a clever cook who talks to animals.
scenes.zh: 每周五，班里都有展示分享。米娅带来一本古书，书中的主角是一位会和动物说话的聪明厨师。

question.answer_en: The main character is a clever cook.
question.answer_zh: 主角是一位聪明的厨师。

scenes.title: The Soup Picture
scenes.en: The book says, “These pictures are important. They show a delicious soup.” Mia smiles because she wants to make it after class.
scenes.zh: 书里说这些图片很重要，因为它们展示了一锅美味的汤。米娅想下课后试着做，所以笑了。

question.answer_en: Because she wants to make the soup.

scenes.title: Brush Films
scenes.en: Ben brings two short films about calligraphy. They are useful: each brush line becomes a little bird, a river, or a dancing dragon.
scenes.zh: 本带来两部关于书法的短片。它们很有用：每一笔都变成了小鸟、河流或跳舞的龙。

question.zh: 这些短片是关于什么的？

scenes.title: A Happy Ending
scenes.en: The class acts out the recipe and the pictures. They have a good time. At the end, the teacher asks, “Which idea will you try at home?”
scenes.zh: 全班把食谱和图片表演出来，大家都玩得很开心。最后，老师问大家回家会尝试哪一个点子。

question.en: Does everyone have a good time?
question.answer_en: Yes, they have a good time.
question.answer_zh: 是的，大家都玩得很开心。
